video.title: FULLTANK SUNDAY: Stop Choosing Comfort Over Growth
video.description:
Choosing comfort over growth keeps you trapped in the same place while expecting a different life. Staying safe might feel comfortable, but God’s best blessings always lie just beyond your comfort zone. When you step into the uncomfortable with faith, holding God's hand, your courage expands and your world gets bigger. 

#FULLTANKwithBroBo #FULLTANKwithBroBo2026 #StopChoosingComfortOverGrowth #Matthew16 #GetBehindMeSatan #StepOutOfYourComfortZone #FaithInAction #SpiritualMaturity #TrulyRichMindset #FaithOverFear #Grace

comments.author: @marie-f1p5q
comments.text:
Bo, this week I’ve been thinking about working really hard so I can save enough money to retire early. But I keep wondering if I can really work that hard. I’m afraid I’m not smart, wise, diligent, or resilient enough. I’m also afraid that my physical and mental health might suffer along the way.

I just want us to have a simple and peaceful life after all the hard work. Guide us, Lord. Please help us. 🙏
